title: Sync from live keeps a merge answer of any size off the command line, and puts in place a table whose collation alone changed
steps: Run the Sync from live flow case with 8000 titles changed on both sides (about 1.2 MB of kept places).
Run the flow case where the live site changes only a table collation, first read and after a stored read.
expect: The sync with 8000 kept places ends applied, with no `Argument list too long`.
The copy takes the live collation (utf8mb3_general_ci) on both reads; its rows stay the same.

tests: a collation the live site changed, with no row changed, reaches the copy
`sync` keeps thousands of places both sides changed
